say:1:1037017001:1.text: It's still a great place to live if comfort and leisure are all you're after.
say:1:1037017001:1.source_cn: 这里还是很不错的，如果只考虑居住舒适度的话。

say:2:1037017002:1.text: But being so isolated, of course, makes one less connected.
say:2:1037017002:1.source_cn: 可是一个人住在这里，消息实在是不大灵通。

say:3:1037017003:1.text: Had I not been told by a passing villager, I might never have learned the truth about the corruption.
say:3:1037017003:1.source_cn: 要不是路过的村民告诉我，我可能到现在还不知道污染的真相。

say:4:1037017004:1.text: When you consider something like this, living among people seems the wiser choice.
say:4:1037017004:1.source_cn: 这么一想，还是和大家生活在一起比较好。
